title: JustinGuitar Lesson 5 Practice Routine: Finger Stretch, Chord Changes, Strumming with Metronome, and Song Practice
summary: This video outlines a structured 20‑minute practice routine for JustinGuitar’s Lesson 5, emphasizing foundational guitar technique and repetition to build accuracy and rhythm. The session starts with a two‑minute finger/stretch warm‑up, then a one‑minute C chord drill (Chord Perfect) followed by targeted chord‑change work (Am to C, then C to E minor). A two‑minute block focuses on strumming with a metronome and keeping timing consistent, then a two‑minute Come As You Are riff exercise. The video then moves into a 10‑minute song practice with suggested songs (Eleanor Rigby, Get Lucky, Black) aimed at reinforcing chord changes and rhythm. It also covers guidance on when to move on (memorizing the Note Circle and C chord, aiming for about 30 changes per minute, practicing at 80–100 BPM) and notes the upcoming G chord for the next lesson, with remarks on rhythm practice, potential play‑along resources, and the Beginner Song Course app as tools to reinforce timing and consistency.
